description: This Java source file defines the `RomAttributeParser` class, which provides static methods for parsing various attribute-related strings and byte data in the context of ROM XML processing for tuning software. It includes methods for endianess, hex strings, storage types, data signs, table types, byte value extraction, integer and float conversions, and file size parsing.

classes.name: RomAttributeParser
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to parse attributes from ROM XML and byte data.

methods.name: parseEndian
methods.description: Parses the input string to determine the endianess (big or little) based on input or predefined settings.

methods.name: parseHexString
methods.description: Converts a hex string, possibly with '0x' prefix or '0' value, to an integer.

methods.name: parseStorageType
methods.description: Parses string representing storage type such as float, uint, or int, returning corresponding internal constants.

methods.name: parseStorageDataSign
methods.description: Determines if storage data is signed based on the string (e.g., starting with 'int').

methods.name: parseScaleType
methods.description: Parses scale type string to either inverse or linear constant.

methods.name: parseTableType
methods.description: Determines the table type (3D, 2D, X axis, Y axis, 1D) based on input string and settings.

methods.name: parseByteValue
methods.description: Extracts a numeric value from a byte array with specified endianess, address, length, and signedness.

methods.name: parseIntegerValue
methods.description: Converts an integer to a byte array considering endianess.

methods.name: parseFileSize
methods.description: Parses a string representing file size with optional 'kb' or 'mb' suffix into an integer number of bytes.

methods.name: floatToByte
methods.description: Converts a float value into a byte array, respecting endianess.

methods.name: byteToFloat
methods.description: Converts a byte array into a float value, respecting endianess.
